title: Beaufort Learning Harbor v10.42
notes: Adds reusable browser-local week templates, additive duplicate-safe template application, non-destructive duplicate-week and roll-forward operations, workload/day/target analysis, target-aware time-conflict warnings, clearer co-op responsibility gaps, and optional learner-safe print/CSV output with adult-only notes excluded. Preserves source weeks, existing target plans, linked Assignment and Lesson Pack records, role boundaries, offline behavior, console quietness, bounded DOM activity, and all reward, attendance, mastery, portfolio, source-record, and preliminary curriculum boundaries.
